title: Count of Smaller Numbers After Self
description: Given an integer array nums, return an integer array counts where counts[i] is the number of smaller elements to the right of nums[i].
pseudocode:
1. Initialize counts array with 0s
2. Use a sorted list to keep track of seen elements
3. Iterate backwards through nums
4. Find the insertion index of nums[i] in the sorted list
5. Add the index to counts
6. Insert nums[i] into the sorted list

steps.note: Initialize counts with zeros for input [5, 2, 6, 1]
Start iteration from the end (index 3, value 1)
Insert 1 into empty sorted list. Smaller elements: 0
6 is greater than 1. Insertion index is 1. Smaller: 1
2 is greater than 1, less than 6. Insertion index is 1. Smaller: 1
5 is greater than 1 and 2, less than 6. Insertion index is 2. Smaller: 2
